page.overview:
Who is The Black Dragon?

The Black Dragon is a character in the promotional comics/media from Hasbro.

The Black Dragon is the villain of the Ninja Battles comic from Hasbro, that came packed into the Ninja Battles 5-pack action figure set.

The Black Dragon was a former member of the Arashikage Clan and the Sword Brother of the Iron Master, before The Black Dragon turned evil.

The Black Dragon kidnaps the apprentices of the two warring Ninjas clans, and steals their halves of the Arashikage Medalion to reunite the pieces under the Fire Moon to obtain ultimate power.
